He also reports hematuria, which is difficult to detect but notes a change in urine color (faint pinkish tint), and dizziness on exertion. Tylenol provides minimal relief. The patient does not report numbness or weakness, but he does feel some body aches because he is favoring his back when he walks. The patient has not experienced any recent changes in bowel movements or swelling in the legs.
